title: 공군미사일방어사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:29321:20181204:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Decree on Operational Commands <Presidential Decree No. 29321, December 4, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2019.
Article 2
Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (4) Omitted.
(5) Part of the Decree on the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command shall be amended as follows:
The heading of Article 5, "(Maintenance of Military Morals)", shall be replaced with "(Maintenance of Military Discipline)", and "military morals (風紀)" in the text of that Article shall be replaced with "military discipline (軍紀)".
(6) through (16) Omitted.
Article 4
Omitted.
